SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

The following is the statement of......Wu Chen-liang (吴成樑)

at Police Hdqrs. on the October 7, 1940 and interpreted by......C.A. Loh Sin-kye ...

My name is Wu Chen-liang, age 29. For 14 years,
I have been sent by the "Sin Wan Pao" to be a reporter in
the Court. After the occurrence of the murder of Chow Yung-
chi (周永志) by his two sons, I began to write a book
entitled "Violation of Human Relationship" (倫变) with
the assistance of other Court reporters with the object of
improving the good custom of the general public.

On September 25 or 26, Mr. Paul Ru, Assistant
Municipal Advocate, whilst in the Court sought information
from me about the material contained in the book and the
object of the writing of the book "Violation of Human
Relationship". In reply, I said that the book would
contain entirely the minutes of the Court proceedings of the
case, while a section of the contents had been secured from
Chow Chin Sz (周经氏) and the relatives and friends of the
deceased. I added that the object of the writing of the
book was to correct the mistakes of the people with the
example set aside by the Chow brothers.

By September 28, I intended to send a detailed
explanation to the Legal Department, but seeing Paul Ru in
the Court, was told by him that it was not necessary and that
if the Special Branch of the Police should bring up the
matter in future, I could deal with the Special Branch.
My experience told me that the Legal Department had referred
back the case to the Special Branch and that no legal action
would be taken.

Shun Pao and others (30.9.40):

BOOK "VIOLATION OF HUMAN RELATIONSHIP" EXAMINED BY THE
SPECIAL BRANCH

Chow Ching-chi (周欽吉) and Chow Ching-ziang (周緻祥),
two brothers, killed their father Chow Yung-chi (周永杰) by
means of electrocution, and afterwards they attempted to destroy
their father's dead body by mutilating it. As a result of Court
proceedings, they were both sentenced to death, while their
mother Chow Chin Sz (周經氏), the victim's wife, was sentenced
to two years and six months' imprisonment on the suspicion of
having rendered assistance in the execution of the crime.

The Hwa Kwang News Agency (華光社), No.44 Yunnan Road,
has now published a book entitled "Violation of Human Relationship"
(倫變), giving details of the above murder case. In view of
the fact that this book is suspected of inducing people to commit
crime, the Special Branch of the Municipal Police has submitted
it to the Municipal Advocate for examination with a view to
taking legal action according to the Press Law. The book was
perused by Mr. Paul Hu, Assistant Municipal Advocate, who
concluded that the book contains nothing which may impair good
morals or public order as stipulated in the Press Law. It is
a substantially correct account of the case and the biographies
of the persons involved. Furthermore, a part of the contents
of the book has also appeared in newspapers. Thus, it cannot
be regarded as one that may induce people to commit crime.

It has been decided not to take action against this
book. The case was therefore returned to the Special Branch.

特务科审查《伦变》一书

周钦吉（周欽吉）和周緻祥（周緻祥）两兄弟，
通过电击手段杀害了其父周永杰（周永杰），随后试图通过肢解
其父尸体来毁尸灭迹。经法庭审理，两人均被判处死刑，而其母周经氏（周經氏），即受害者之妻，因涉嫌协助实施犯罪而被判处
两年六个月监禁。

位于云南路44号的华光社（華光社）
现已出版一本名为《伦变》
(倫變) 的书，详细介绍了上述谋杀案。鉴于
该书涉嫌诱导人们犯罪，工部局警务处特务科已将其
提交市政检察官审查，以便根据新闻法采取
法律行动。助理市政检察官胡保罗（Paul Hu）先生审阅了该书，
结论是该书不包含新闻法规定的任何可能有损良好
道德或公共秩序的内容。该书对案件及相关人员
传记的描述基本属实。此外，该书部分内容也曾在
报纸上刊登。因此，不能将其视为可能诱导人们犯罪的书籍。

已决定不对此书采取行动。因此，该案已退回特务科。

Commissioner of Police:

In re: "Violation of Human Relationship"
Your No. D. 9497.

We have thoroughly perused the above entitled publication and have come to the conclusion that it contains nothing which impinges upon the Laws of the Republic of China, the Land Regulations and Bye-Laws, or any legal procedure. It is a substantially correct account of a homicide case tried in the Shanghai First Special Area District Court and which is still pending on appeal. While we agree that the book cannot serve any good purpose, it is no worse than many stories which appear in English magazines.

The Chief Judge of the Criminal Division of the Shanghai First Special Area District Court has been consulted and he agrees with our opinion.

The file is returned, herewith.

R. T. Bryan, Jr.

Commissioner of Police.
Sir,
Since the conviction of a mother and two sons
for a crime of homicide as detailed in F.I.R. 2492/39,
B'Well (Legal Department registration No. 9/7103-5), there
have been several attempts to present theatrical plays
and cinematograph films of this crime. All efforts in
this direction have been frustrated by Special Branch.
Small pamphlets and articles in magazines written with
reference to the crime have appeared despite all efforts
of the Police to ban this undesirable form of reading
matter.
A book of some length entitled "Violation of
Human Relationship" (倫變) has now appeared on the
market. The book is printed in the Chinese language
by Ih Sing Publishing Company (一心出版社) and was, according
to the fly-leaf, written by four Chinese citizens. From
a summary translation made in Special Branch, it does not
appear that the book goes very far beyond the truthful
or alleged truthful facts of the crime. There is, however,
a second appeal still pending in the Court. The book
obviously cannot serve any good purpose but it is not any
worse than "Thrillers" which appear in foreign magazines
and are on sale in Shanghai. I cannot find sufficient
ground on which to prohibit the sale of the book but
suggest that the opinion of the Municipal Advocate be
obtained.

Yes
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 26 SEPT. 1940）

R. O. Yorke.
D. C. (Special Branch)

自一名母亲和两个儿子因如初步报案记录 2492/39 中详述的杀人罪被判刑以来（静安寺法律部注册号 9/7103-5），曾有多次尝试将此罪行搬上舞台剧和电影银幕。特务科挫败了所有此类努力。尽管警方尽力禁止这种不良读物，但仍出现了提及该罪行的小册子和杂志文章。
现在市场上出现了一本篇幅较长的书，名为《伦变》（倫變）。该书由一心出版社用中文印刷，据扉页所示，由四位中国公民撰写。根据特务科制作的摘要译文，该书似乎并未超出真实或声称真实的犯罪事实范围太远。然而，法院仍有第二次上诉待决。这本书显然无法起到任何有益作用，但它并不比在上海出售的外国杂志上出现的“惊悚小说”更糟糕。本人找不到足够的理由禁止销售该书，但建议征求市政检察官的意见。

SEP 1 4 1940

OFF THE RECORD

（批：Get a copy Roy / SS / Fu）
（批：2 e S B / p. 2）

Inhuman
Resourceful newsmen have compiled into a book form, in Chinese, the now nationally known patricide case which rocked Shanghai a year ago. Briefly the crime was committed by two brothers with their father as victim, by electrocution. Although the case is not yet completely out of the courts—an appeal to the highest court here is still pending—the editors of this book while demonstrating their highly imaginative ability have succeeded in rendering the cold-blooded murder into a highly gripping tragedy.

Flourishing
A sociologist who has made considerable study of Shanghai's prostitution situation told OFF THE RECORD that the city has no less than 57 so-called "Girl Guide Bureaux." The exact number of "girl guides" has never been ascertained; but according to the sociologist, the total is no less than 1,200. On the average these young women, most of them being in their teens, work from five to six hours a day, at the rate of $1 per hour. From this estimate he estimated that Shanghailanders daily spend no less than 7,500 hours in being entertained by these girls. Non-listed "Girl Guide Bureaux" have not been checked, the 57 establishments mentioned above can be located by the use of the telephone directory.

Rumor-Mongering
Several vernacular papers certainly made much over the temporary closure of the Palace des Sports. Possibly inspired by gamblers who have lost in that establishment. At any rate, one said the Hai Alai players had struck for better pay. Another said the place was under repairs. The truth is that all players are well-satisfied with what they are earning and therefore have no desire to demand for more. The temporary closure is due, we are told on good authority, to injuries having been inflicted on a number of the players, thus making the continued operation of the establishment for the time being undesirable, and possibly unprofitable.

一位对上海卖淫状况进行过大量研究的社会学家告诉“非公开记录”栏目，本市至少有57家所谓的“向导女局”。“向导女”的确切人数从未查明；但据该社会学家称，总数不少于1,200人。平均而言，这些年轻女性大多处于十几岁的年龄段，每天工作五至六小时，每小时收费1美元。根据这一估算，他推测上海居民每天花费在这些女子陪伴娱乐上的时间不少于7,500小时。未列入名录的“向导女局”未经核查，上述57家机构可通过电话簿查到。

散布谣言
几家中文报纸肯定对体育宫（Palace des Sports）的暂时关闭大肆渲染。这可能是受在该场所输钱的赌徒唆使。无论如何，一家报纸称海阿莱（Hai Alai）球员为争取更高薪酬而罢工。另一家则称该场所正在维修。事实是，所有球员对目前的收入都很满意，因此无意要求加薪。据可靠消息来源告知，暂时关闭的原因是多名球员受伤，致使该场所目前继续运营变得不合时宜，甚至可能无利可图。

successfully produced, it is tantamount to a teaching on

promote education through motion pictures. We wonder whether

story will be permitted to be produced.
